description: Phase 4 MerLin ADAPTATION (not the paper's model): 6 modes, N photons (default 2; --n-photons 3), U-z-U-z-U re-uploading, threshold detection with collision-free postselection; unbiased readout with 18 trainable per-mode response vectors (no bias). Protocol paper, author training data, Adam lr 1e-3, 2000 steps.
